title: The Wrong Cup
descriptionRu: Тому в кафе дают не тот кофе, и он это исправляет.

paragraphs.text: Tom stopped at his favorite café before work to order a large black coffee. The café was busy, and a long line stretched almost to the door. He waited patiently, checking his watch every few minutes because his break was short.

When his name was finally called, Tom grabbed the cup from the counter and hurried outside. After a few steps he took a sip and stopped in surprise — it was sweet, milky, and definitely not his order. Someone had made a mistake with the cups.

Tom walked back inside and explained politely what had happened. The barista apologized and quickly made a new cup, this time black and strong. Tom thanked her, checked his watch again, and rushed off to work with coffee in hand.

questions.prompt: Why did Tom go back inside the café?
How did the barista react to the mistake?
The café was so ___ that Tom had to wait in a long line.
